positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Sole developer in creating desktop application with python to automate work for production department, resulting in over 90% time savings
-Led the implementation of new processes and creation of relevant resources for production department, reducing repetitive work
-Utilized Python with Boto3 for managing company assets with S3
-Created solution for automated SMS list building with PHP and Callfire
-Assisted in creating functionality on customer order form pages with JavaScript
-Utilized 250ok and other systems to ensure email marketing best practices and consistent html email templates
-Provided training and onboarding for new hires

positions.title: Warehouse Engineer
positions.description:
-Created software solutions to assist in custom warehouse projects using predominantly php, sql, and command line
-Maintained and monitored system servers and processes
-Provided basic IT support to warehouse

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
-Created new web application for payroll processing as a key developer using BBj, MS SQL Server, and CSS
-Connected functionality of existing .net application to new payroll app using BBj and JavaScript
-Performed QA testing to discover underlying bugs in programs and programming language (BBj)

positions.title: US Ocean IE Supervisor
positions.description:
-Supervised and trained the Industrial Engineer Specialist
-Co-leader on two projects for new work measurements

positions.title: IE Global Freight Forwarding Specialist
positions.description:
-Conducted data gathering and analysis utilizing MS SQL Server, Toad for Oracle, MS Access, Excel, and Visual Basic 
-Automated repetitive tasks using Windows PowerShell, MS SQL Server, Windows Task Scheduler, Excel, and Visual Basic
-Redesigned major yearly reports and eliminated manual work using Excel, Microsoft Access, and MS SQL Server

positions.title: Senior Design Project Intern
positions.description:
-Performed a redesign of HNI’s 150,000 sq ft. southern regional distribution center. 
-Worked with a team to help change the build and storage method from a load zone process currently in place at the facility to a customer zone process. 
-Improved productivity and quality by reducing product touches by clamp trucks. Improved distribution, handling & flow; increasing weekly shipments to over 500,000 cubage. 
-Performed data analysis & forecasts for management. 
-Programmed/created simulation models of the redesigned warehouse in Arena.

positions.title: Loss prevention
positions.description:
-Provided customer and client support in Loss Prevention
-Analyzed transactions to detect possible fraud
-Prepared settlement reports for management
